text:
nina: Morning team — quick async standup before launch preflight.

theo: Yesterday: merged the benchmark harness PR, ran end-to-end tests for audio benchmark.

theo: Blocker: need final warm KV-cache p95 numbers for redwood-xl from infra (seq len 256). Kevin?

kevin: Pulling results now. ETA ~45m. Note: the dedicated pool used a slightly different batch policy; I'll normalize and send CSV.

rachel: Design notes: hero image needs alt text and a smaller asset for mobile. I'll upload updated SVGs to /assets/marketing/ and add mobile mock.

nina: Great. For copy, let's call the public offering "Redwood Hosted (verified)" and in the enterprise sidebar mention Dedicated. Keeping consistent across headline and CTA.

theo: Also a quick ask — can we expose a short-lived staging endpoint for a reproducible curl snippet? Prefer HTTPS & a 48h key.

kevin: Yep, I'll create one and drop the ephemeral key into the doc. Deploy-bot, can you note a canary window?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging -> prod at 2026-06-23 07:00 PT. Approvals pending.

nina: Thanks. Kevin, once you post the key, I'll add the example curl. Proposed snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-xl","input":"Benchmark test","max_tokens":64}'
```

kevin: Ephemeral key uploaded to the doc (expires in 48h). CSV with p50/p95 + conditions also uploaded: seq=256, batch=1, cold-start excluded.

theo: Uploaded an abbreviated table for the marketing post:
```
model,mode,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
redwood-xl,hosted,120,340,0.0072
redwood-xl,dedicated,100,310,0.0066
```

rachel: Design QA done; adjusted heading weight for mobile and added alt text. PNGs in the doc.

olga: Legal flagged the benchmark telemetry blurb. I'll DM a short boilerplate; approve it and we can paste it under methodology.

nina: Plan for today: finalize hero copy, add curl snippet and embed key example, approve final design, merge PR #512 and schedule CMS publish for Tue 09:00 PT.

theo: Reviewing PR #512 now — will leave comments shortly. If clean, I can approve in ~30m.

kevin: No infra maint during the 09:00 PT window. Endpoint will be torn down after key expiry.

nina: Sweet. If anyone hits blockers, ping here. Otherwise I'll mark this done once the PR merges and assets are linked. :rocket:
